scientific_question: After the independently validated v70 full-trajectory compatibility pass, does the fixed exact-stencil tiled p0 rank-8 detector-space proposal plus one exact known-geometry A-transpose lift and one unchanged exact CGLS step retain the 2A+2A-transpose budget as a stable fresh-process wall and memory benefit against Zero-CGLS K4 over all five PoolFire fit trajectories and all three frozen nine-view geometries?
evidence_role: Stage C resource gate for the independently validated v70 exact-stencil tiled p0 candidate. This protocol measures one Mac CPU/software environment and one known-noise-free straight-ray PoolFire proxy family. It is not neural-operator, external-family, curved-ray, calibrated-camera, real-BOST, broad-generalization, novelty, or paper-success evidence.

repair_revision.resource_monitor_revision: reuse the validated v68.3 10 ms sampler, minimum 100 samples, and maximum 250 ms gap without modification

data_contract.observation_generation: noise-free y=A_g*x from the exact frozen target operator, performed once outside every timed worker
data_contract.observation_bundle_layout: one uncompressed C-contiguous observations.npy file with shape (101,9216) per trajectory-by-geometry stratum plus one manifest and checksum ledger
data_contract.independent_observation_reconstruction: the independent validator must reopen the five frozen pair truth arrays, rebuild all three exact operators, regenerate all 1,515 observations, and compare every value with the sealed observation-only bundle

fixed_arms.randomized_factor_algorithm: frozen implementation streams four detector-v rows per tile from the exact operator stencil, applies a NumPy Generator PCG64 Gaussian range finder and reduced QR with zero power iterations, then a final NumPy SVD; the exact implementation source SHA is bound by the execution release
fixed_arms.factor_source: the exact operator stored trilinear stencil; no second ray bundle

worker_contract.one_worker_scope: one trajectory-by-geometry stratum, one arm, all 101 frames
worker_contract.arm_specific_import_fairness: candidate-only NumPy linalg/random submodules are loaded only by the tiled-p0 arm before the runtime audit hook; Zero-K4 does not pay candidate-only import wall or RSS
worker_contract.outer_wall_boundary: controller time.perf_counter immediately before Popen through successful child wait, bounded-schema receipt verification, and process reap
outer_wall_includes: exact-stencil tiled p0 factor construction for the candidate arm, including all streamed tile passes
worker_contract.exact_operator_counter_reset: after exact operator construction and immediately before the first reconstruction
worker_contract.canonical_output_digest: SHA-256 over frames 0..100 in order; for each frame append field as C-contiguous little-endian float64 with fixed shape (8192,), then residual as C-contiguous little-endian float64 with fixed shape (9216,); no header, delimiter, norm, JSON, native-endian, or metadata bytes enter the digest
worker_contract.factor_internal_setup_timer_is_diagnosti: the factor timer begins after the shared exact operator is built and covers the complete exact-stencil tiled p0 construction; only controller outer wall is the primary deployment gate

randomized_complete_block_contract.block_identity: one trajectory-by-geometry stratum and one repetition
randomized_complete_block_contract.schedule_rng: Python random.Random MT19937 in the frozen Python version
randomized_complete_block_contract.schedule_generation: for each frozen stratum in protocol order, assign one arm to first position five times and the other six times; alternate which arm receives six first positions so the global first-position counts are 82 and 83; shuffle the eleven first-position labels with the frozen RNG; emit both adjacent arms for every block

resource_measurement_contract.primary_metric: paired fresh-process outer wall ratio exact-stencil tiled p0 q8-K1 over Zero-K4
resource_measurement_contract.ratio_unit: one candidate outer-wall or RSS value divided by its adjacent control value within the same trajectory-by-geometry repetition block
resource_measurement_contract.global_distribution: all 165 block ratios, exactly eleven from each of fifteen equally represented strata
resource_measurement_contract.per_trajectory_distribution: 33 block ratios from three geometries times eleven repetitions
resource_measurement_contract.per_geometry_distribution: 55 block ratios from five trajectories times eleven repetitions
resource_measurement_contract.per_stratum_distribution: 11 block ratios from one trajectory-by-geometry stratum
resource_measurement_contract.aggregation: for every declared distribution report p50, p90-higher, and worst directly over block ratios; ratio-of-medians, pooled raw arm times, deleted rows, winsorization, and outlier filtering are forbidden
resource_measurement_contract.worker_self_RSS_definition: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss converted to bytes as-is on macOS and multiplied by 1024 on Linux
resource_measurement_contract.sampled_worker_tree_RSS_definition: at each parent-thread sample, sum psutil RSS over the active worker PID and all recursively discovered descendant PIDs exactly once
resource_measurement_contract.sampled_controller_plus_worker_pipeline_: at the same sample instant, add controller-process psutil RSS to the sampled unique-PID worker-tree RSS; the monitor executes in a controller thread and has no separate PID
resource_measurement_contract.maximum_gap_rationale: The validated v68.3 monitor calibration fixed a 10 ms requested interval, at least 100 samples, and a 250 ms maximum blind window. This v70.1 gate reuses those result-independent sampling thresholds without modification; worker-self ru_maxrss remains the high-water measurement and sampled process-tree scopes remain explicit lower bounds.
resource_measurement_contract.host_quiescence_contract: From the first reference launch through formal READY, no deliberate Codex subagent, test, smoke, training, build, download, indexing, or other CPU- or memory-intensive workload may run on this Mac. Ordinary OS background activity is disclosed but cannot be eliminated.
resource_measurement_contract.controller_baseline_RSS_definition: the controller RSS at the monitor's first successful sample for each worker, reported separately from worker-tree and controller-plus-worker pipeline peaks
resource_measurement_contract.sampled_RSS_scope_disclosure: sampled worker-tree and controller-plus-worker maxima are process-tree lower bounds at the frozen sampling interval, not mathematically exact instantaneous peaks

independent_validator_must_recompute: the current v70 Stage B parent seal, 1,515-of-1,515 compatibility result, independent-validation binding, and unchanged payload hashes by reopening the release-bound parent result root
all 1,515 observations from the five frozen pair truth arrays and three exact operators, plus observation manifest and payload identities
all 30 arm-by-stratum reference field and residual digests without importing the formal worker or controller
block adjacency, balance, uniqueness, and interval non-overlap
per-worker actual A, A-transpose, and cheap-action ledgers
all paired wall and RSS ratios
all global, trajectory, geometry, and stratum summaries
correctness_and_integrity_contract.independent_reference_replay: use the frozen numerical core directly, not the formal worker/controller; reproduce each arm, each frame, canonical digest, norm sums, and actual logical call ledger
correctness_and_integrity_contract.independent_validator_role: independent observation reconstruction, reference-output replay, aggregation, and execution-ledger audit; it does not independently reproduce OS timing

pass_requires: The validated v70 Stage B parent remains unchanged and authorizes Stage C.
The sealed observation-only bundle contains exactly 15 finite float64 arrays of shape (101,9216), and timed workers read no truth or forbidden trajectory.
Every non-timed reference and all 330 timed workers have the frozen roster, digest, actual call ledger, thread state, and immutable execution closure.
All 165 adjacent two-arm blocks are complete, randomized, position-balanced within every stratum, and temporally non-overlapping.
The global paired outer-wall p50 and p90-higher gates pass.
Every trajectory paired outer-wall p50 no-harm gate passes, with all geometry and stratum tails reported.
Worker-self, sampled worker-tree, and sampled controller-plus-worker pipeline RSS p90-higher gates all pass.
The independent validator exactly reproduces every roster, ledger, paired statistic, gate, and final decision from immutable raw receipts.
decision_rule.decision_precedence: First establish a complete valid execution. Any integrity, environment, observation, schedule, digest, ledger, monitor, or independent-validation defect is INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_EXECUTION and cannot become scientific FAIL or PASS. Only a complete independently validated batch may be judged PASS or FAIL from wall and RSS gates.
fail_if: A complete independently validated batch violates any global wall or RSS gate.
A complete independently validated batch violates any trajectory wall or RSS no-harm gate.
inconclusive_if: A worker, monitor, controller, or independent validator fails before a complete auditable batch exists.
The OS timing or RSS receipts cannot be matched to an intact adjacent block.
The execution environment or sealed observation bundle changes during the run.
Any worker output digest or actual call ledger differs from its independently replayed reference or protocol.
The exact-stencil tiled p0 factor setup is moved outside the worker, builds a second ray bundle, or observations are generated inside timed workers.
Any worker is retried, any row is deleted, or any partial timing row is reused.

failure_action.if_wall_fails: Record the exact negative result. Do not call the 50 percent exact-operator reduction a speedup and do not hide tiled factor setup by caching factors outside the worker.
failure_action.if_memory_fails: Record the exact negative result and close the current exact-stencil tiled p0 resource claim; do not keep a speed-only PASS.
failure_action.if_one_trajectory_fails: Record the trajectory-specific harm and fail Stage C even if the pooled median passes.
failure_action.if_inconclusive: Repair only the identified execution defect, create a new protocol revision, and never reuse partial timing rows as formal evidence.
